points.point: What's wrong with my body (wrong endpoint or schema)
points.sentence: Legacy POST /v2/videos/creations uses a template object and a different schema. Current POST /v2/videos/from-templates uses templateId and inputs.

points.point: Fix: send the templateId body to the current endpoint
points.sentence: Use its complete ID in templateId and send the matching body to POST /v2/videos/from-templates.

verdict.reason: The customer posts a templateId and inputs body to the legacy /v2/videos/creations endpoint, and this entry's quoted sentences state that this endpoint uses a different schema and that the current endpoint is /v2/videos/from-templates.
